in_sanskrit.name: चैत्रांजन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is born in the month of Chaitra (March-April)

in_hindi.name: चैत्रांजन
in_hindi.long_meaning: जो चैत्र माह में पैदा हुआ है

in_marathi.name: Chaitranjan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chaitranjan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chaitra refers to the first month of Hindu calendar and Jana means 'born'. Thus, Chaitranjan signifies 'the reflection of the moon during the first month of Hindu calendar'.

in_bengali.name: Chaitranjan
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Moon's Reflection
in_bengali.long_meaning: Chaitranjan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Chaitra refers to the first month of Hindu calendar and Jana means 'born'. Thus, Chaitranjan signifies 'the reflection of the moon during the first month of Hindu calendar'.
